Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live"

SPECIFICATION  FOR  PLAIN  WASHERS  WJTH% 
OUTSIDE  DIAMETER  *3  x  INSIDE  DIAMETER 


1,  Scope  — The   requirements  for  plain  washers  with  outside  diameter  approximately  equal  to  thrke 

inside  diameter. 

2-  Typos  —  The  washers  shall  be  of  two  type*,  namely,  Type  A  Washers  whkh  are  unmachined;  and  Type  0 

Washers  which  are  machined.

Note  —  Sizes  in  brackets  are  of  second  preference. 

4.  Material  —  Washers  covered  In  this  standard  shall  be  made  from  steel,  brass,  aluminium  or  any  other 
suitable  material  as  specified  by  the  purchaser. 

5.  Designation    -  The  washers  shall  be  designated  by  the  type,  nominal  size,  the  number  of  this  standard 
and  material. 

Example' 

A  plain  washer  (outside  diameter  w3x  Inside  diameter)  of  Type  B  having  a  nominal  size  of 
4*3  mm  and  made  of  steel  shall  be  designated  as; 

Washer  B  4-3  IS  :  5370  Steel. 

6.  Other  Requirements  —  Other  requirements  for  the  plain  washers  not  covered  In  this  standard,  Shalt 
conform  to  15:5369-196** 


•General  requirements  for  plain  washers  and  lock  wajher*- 


Thls  standard  Is  based  on  DIN  9021-1956.
